blocks.title: Introduction
blocks.content: Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a finite tensor category over an algebraically closed field ${\Bbbk}$ of characteristic zero. A *fiber functor* on $\mathcal{C}$ is a ${\Bbbk}$-linear exact faithful tensor functor $F:\mathcal{C}\to\mathop{\mathrm{Vec}}_{{\Bbbk}}$. Classical neutral Tannakian duality reconstructs affine group schemes from symmetric tensor categories equipped with a fiber functor [@Saavedra72; @DM82]. blocks.title: The equivariant category CG and its module categories
blocks.content:
Given a $G$-action on a tensor category $\mathcal{C}$, one forms the *equivariant category* $\mathcal{C}^G$.

Its objects are pairs $(X, u)$ where $X \in \mathcal{C}$ and $u = \{u_g: g_*(X) \to X\}_{g \in G}$ is a collection of isomorphisms satisfying $u_{gh} = u_g \circ g_*(u_h)$ for all $g, h \in G$ and $u_e = \operatorname{id}_X$. The tensor product is $(X, u) \otimes (Y, v) = (X \otimes Y, w)$, where $w_g = u_g \otimes v_g$, and the unit object is $(\mathbf{1}, \operatorname{id}_{\mathbf{1}})$.

blocks.title: The correspondence between fiber functors and rank-one module categories
blocks.content:
A *fiber functor* on a finite tensor category $\mathcal{C}$ is an exact faithful tensor functor $F:\mathcal{C}\to\mathop{\mathrm{Vec}}_{{\Bbbk}}$. We use the monoidal constraints $$F_2:F(X)\otimes F(Y)\xrightarrow{\sim}F(X\otimes Y),
\qquad
F_0:{\Bbbk}\xrightarrow{\sim}F(\mathbf1),$$ and identify fiber functors that are monoidally naturally isomorphic. A $\mathcal{C}$-module category has *rank one* if its underlying abelian category is equivalent to $\mathop{\mathrm{Vec}}_{{\Bbbk}}$.

We next characterize when $\mathcal{M}^H$ has rank one. Since $H$ is finite and $\operatorname{char}({\Bbbk})=0$, Tambara's theorem gives $$\mathcal{M}^H\text{ semisimple}\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad \mathcal{M}\text{ semisimple}$$ [@T01 Proposition 5.2].
